title: Preserving prefix agreement by updating an assignment
statement: Let $\sigma,\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$ and $i\in\mathbb{N}$. If $\sigma$ and $\tau$ agree at every index below $i$, then the assignment obtained from $\sigma$ by setting its value at $i$ to $\tau(i)$ agrees with $\tau$ at every index below $i+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ and $\tau$ are Boolean assignments to natural-number variables
